messages:
Evelyn Park: Quick follow-up from the security all-hands Q&A, posting answers and actions about ISO readiness, evidence SLAs, VPC connectivity, and audit log exports.
Ravi Singh: Thanks Evelyn. Can you confirm the formal SLA for evidence requests (SOC2/ISO) if a customer asks for a historic log bundle?
Evelyn Park: SLA is 5 business days for standard evidence bundles. For audit windows we have an expedited lane (48 hours) if customer purchases the compliance add-on or we enable priority support with legal engagement.
Clara Gomez: For the expedited lane, what's the process to request it? Is it a ticket or an email to security-ops?
Evelyn Park: Open a ticket in Support with subject prefix "EXPEDITE-AUDIT" and tag the account manager. Security-ops will triage and assign a lead. We'll also include a quick intake form link after this thread.
Ben Wu: Regarding Private deployments: do we provide any pre-built ISO artifacts (e.g., config manifests, hardening scripts)?
Evelyn Park: Yes, we'll publish a "Private: ISO readiness pack" with baseline CIS-like hardening scripts, example systemd unit hardening, and an inventory of artifacts we can provide during an audit. ETA: 2 weeks.
Leah Brooks: Will the pack include sample evidence export commands? e.g. a one-liner to pull signed logs?
Evelyn Park: Yes. Example we'll provide: `./rdwctl export-logs --since 2025-03-01 --signed --dest s3://example-bucket` and a short runbook for signing verification.
Ravi Singh: On VPC peering/private link: any changes to networking evidence we can produce (routes, flow logs)? Customers need documented proofs for ISO auditors.
Evelyn Park: We can provide signed flow-log exports, peering/neighbors screenshots, and Terraform state snapshots if customers use our reference module. We'll include a checklist of accepted artifacts per major cloud.
Clara Gomez: Audit logs retention question: what's the default retention for hosted vs dedicated vs private?
Evelyn Park: Hosted: 365 days (indexed), Dedicated: configurable up to 365 days, Private: retention is customer-controlled; we provide guidance and export tooling.
Ben Wu: For BYOK, can we confirm whether key rotation events are logged and if those logs are part of the evidence bundle?
Evelyn Park: Rotation events are logged and included in evidence bundles with key metadata (key-id, rotation-timestamp, actor). For BYOK in Private we log the KMS API calls if the cloud KMS integration is enabled.
Leah Brooks: OpsBot: drop links to the draft ISO pack and the evidence intake form please.
OpsBot: ISO readiness pack (draft): <https://redwood.internal/docs/private-iso-pack-draft|private-iso-pack-draft>. Evidence intake form: <https://forms.redwood/internal/evidence-intake|evidence-intake>.
Ravi Singh: For customers requesting joint audits (Redwood + customer infra), what's the expected scoping call duration and attendees?
Evelyn Park: We run a 60-minute scoping call: security lead (Redwood), account's security owner, infra admin, and optionally legal/compliance. We'll capture scoping notes and add to the audit runbook.
Clara Gomez: Action items? I'd like to assign owners so we can close this out.
Evelyn Park: Actions I'll write down: (1) Publish ISO readiness pack (owner: Clara) ETA 14 days; (2) Create evidence intake shortcut + template (owner: Ravi) ETA 3 business days; (3) Document expedited evidence SLA process (owner: Ben) ETA 5 business days; (4) Add examples of signed log export commands to docs (owner: Leah) ETA 7 days.
Ben Wu: I'll start the SLA doc.
Ravi Singh: I'll wire up the intake form and sample responses.
Clara Gomez: I'll assemble the pack and include Terraform + system hardening examples.
Leah Brooks: I'll add the runbook snippets and the `rdwctl` usage examples.
Evelyn Park: Thanks all. We'll post an update in #announcements when the pack and docs are live. Scheduling a 30-min office hours next Thursday for customer security questions, invite will follow. :calendar:
Ravi Singh: :thumbsup:
